notes.title: Saved seeds + Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Today's update is a rather small one with just a few fixes and one new feature: [b]a seed-saving system[/b]. You can now save seeds that you like through the pause menu in-game, and the death screen. Your saved seeds are accessible in the Saved Seeds menu which is in the New Game menu.

We hope you find this addition useful. As always, any and all feedback is welcome!

notes.title: NPC Update + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b] Hey everyone! [/b]

Today’s update has something special in store for any player who’s ever been curious about the strange little folk in the Polyverse…

That’s right, we’d added new NPC content!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/c04ed3ecdf64ef4523f6d3ddc2b02f6f7acca3ef.jpg[/img]

Dr Dando, everyone’s favourite nutty Zoologist, has some new information about the creatures in Polygod, and if you’re lucky, a tale about the origins of Faceless the First. It turns out he’s quite a chatty guy.

Maya’s got some new musings, too, on her preferred topic of... you guessed it: FREEDOM! But will she ever actually be free as a bee? (Hint: yes. We game devs took pity on her and made it so.)

If you care to chat to the other NPCs, I’m sure you’ll spot a new line here or there, or perhaps a pun that would even make Faceless facepalm.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/7ad470f0a1bc3f1ea1b05e2294b3f60e466a6d92.jpg[/img]

We've also changed the sizes of the levels: they no longer get bigger as you progress through the game. They're all the same size as the first level. Let us know how you find this change, as it will affect balance, difficulty and the time it takes to complete the game.

Have fun!

notes.title: Balance Changes and Special Blessings!
notes.notes:
Today's patch is quite a large one where we have fixed a few bugs, improved the balance of the game and added two special state blessings which cannot be bought and can only be achieved by meeting specific requirements. However we are very excited to introduce the new content and fixes to the community!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/eaf06f7ecd4b3f74ab22e0e87627a6c58dd47f5d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/dd161e95d297edf68501c0ec0348134ee097d647.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/3d36cdad2000a5e80fd50719005e86ff6fe54848.jpg[/img]

[h1]Blessed are the Meek[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/cd605cb37cc51aa4807903552fcbcc818fe732ef.png[/img]
Blessed are the Meek is a blessings bestowed to you by Truth who will increase your damage if your are on a level with a particularly under-powered weapon. We implemented this change to balance for players who received unfair or unworkable seeds due to a lack of base fire power. this also allows players to ride out weaker builds to a later stage in the game where they can acquire the damage at which blessed are the meek will no longer be active.


[h1]Simple Sinner[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/6b6f8c4f6de85be9f70ab1462c1386fa28e0ee3a.png[/img]
Simple sinner was created to encourage hardcore player and speed runners. After beating the first Holy Champion certain Faceless Ones (namely faceless Ones who don't have any blessings) will feel empowered and this resolve and inner strength will weaken future Holy Champions. This means it is now possible to beat the entire game without buying any blessings, this is of course very difficult.

notes.title: Massive Multiplayer Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/8978c20955e720afc86fdafac335ad5bf9e83497.png[/img]

Today I'm very excited to bring you our largest and longest in development update yet! This update is all about Jolly Co-operation as we've finally completed the much requested Co-Op multiplayer option while also improving and polishing our multiplayer versus mode and other multiplayer features.

[h1]Co-operative Multiplayer[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/e36ab79e941d2451901fe49b06fd6c2cdf648a60.jpg[/img]


Players must work together to gather souls and acquire blessings in order to defeat the Holy Champions. The gods will offer the same blessings to players at a particular altar however if another player takes a particular blessing it will not be removed from the blessings on offer from the god. This is because the Gods can bestow infinite blessings and are not limited by mortals choices. Up to 4 players can play together in Co-Operative mode. 

The following blessings have been left out of Co-Op for complexity reasons and will be added in a future update: Whirlwind Shot, Stun Shot, Power Lease.

[h1]Multiplayer Versus[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/f69ad24ecb9ab406ca6301c37452a851f3c35b67.jpg[/img]

Multiplayer Versus has finally been reactivated with all the relevant single player blessings included. None of the boss blessings are available in versus mode as none of the players defeat any Holy Champions in this mode and the boss blessings can be quite unbalanced if used against other players. All playable characters are unlocked for all players while we test our multiplayer modes so that the Early Access community can help us balance all these characters. In the final release players will only be able to access characters they have unlocked in single player for multiplayer. Some single player blessings such as Select Next or Divine Intervention which only work with Altars have are not present in Versus mode. Private game functionality has been added to versus mode.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug regarding floating jump pads in Level 5.
[*]Fixed a bug where Kanox rediscovered levitation in Level 4.[/list]

[b]Added Content[/b]
[list][*]Online Cooperative Multiplayer.
[*]Ark has been given a conclusion to his narrative.
[*]Added fountains to the Garden of Gaia.[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list][*]Wrathful Endeavour's explosions now instantly kill enemies.
[*]Torpedo Shot's torpedoes now instantly kill enemies.
[*]Hand of Mazu's travel distance before the bullet clones appear has been decreased.
Pulsating Core's frequency of pulse bursts has been increased.[/list]

notes.title: The Chaotic Update!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/2b38274e589094d24ea445874bc0800e3705ddba.png[/img]

After far too long of a delay we are proud to introduce our biggest update yet, the Chaotic Update. In this update we have added the sixth level and boss fight, updated the random generation system, daily dungeon leaderboard, updated all the boss fights and prepared the servers for the upcoming online co-operative multiplayer update which has been a major undertaking.

[h1]Level 6 Chaos the Abyss[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/57504482240edd9863915f683c640237ca273a81.png[/img]

The most notable part of this update is the addition of level 6 and its respective boss fight. This level is called the Abyss of Chaos.

[h1]New Boss Power ups with Chaos' Holy Champion![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/c1226f05d31180166ce922a77eb907ccfeb5a956.png[/img]
[b]Chaotic Corruption[/b]
Adds a damage multiplier to your bullets based on the distance the bullet has travelled. The shorter the distance the higher the multiplier. Does not stack.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/f713d0b9acaf8dc905e127ffd933f8fa52526f43.png[/img]
[b]Chaos Armour[/b]
Gives a 25% damage reduction. Acquiring additional Chaos Armour blessings will increase the percentage of damage reduction.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/d0126d4ab3eb3abf1706d6b7f54309bb32ea96c1.png[/img]
[b]Arm of Chaos[/b]
Activates a melee attack when you tap the 'R' key. The melee attack kills beasts instantly. Arm of Chaos has a 10 second cooldown. Acquiring additional Arm of Chaos blessings will decrease the cooldown by 5 seconds.

[h1]For the speed runners[/h1]
[list]
[*]Blessings are now linked to the dungeon seed. This means that for any particular seed the blessings which spawn will be the same every-time. The implication of this is that now for the daily dungeon the time that someone gets will be 100% representative of player skill as the only differentiating factors are player decisions.

[*]Timelines built into the blessing link. We thought it would be fun to create alternate timelines which are triggered by using red portals (the harder alternative boss fights). When a red portal is used the future blessing spawns for a seed are changed according to a timeline with a red portal. Every-time a red portal is used a new timeline opens up with a different set of blessings unique to that seed. This means that speed runners should optimally check all the alternate timelines to find the most efficient combinations of blessings for a particular seed in order to get the best time possible.
[/list]

[h1]Boss Health bars[/h1]
We thought it was about time we added names to our bosses as well as on screen health bars for them. The health bar is visible in the bottom right hand of the screen creating a diagonal symmetry with the player health bar.

[h1]Multiplayer temporarily disabled for Online Co-op Preparation[/h1]
We have made huge amounts of progress in the complicated endeavour of adding full online cooperative multiplayer functionality to the game. We are almost ready to add Online Co-op to the working build but want to perform a few more tests first. We have temporarily disabled the multiplayer menu while we work on the servers and stress test them for the co-op implementation which will also include an update to the multiplayer versus mode. This implementation is planned for our next update!

Introducing Dr Dando and the Mysterious Tau. These two have some new information about this strange other world that you constantly find yourself in.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/a7ae41f9f1c1fb72b598ca1b31bafcec2a1d8f5e.jpg[/img]

Brontes has also received an extreme makeover and now features a higher polygon count.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/8253cd271a8f4622f74054765128c18c3c0ccdd0.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/fa3410870ceebe8030dce4307ea70135c7bc3d79.png[/img]

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
The largest piece of content from the update is the addition of Partial Controller Support. We designed the system to work with Xbox 360 controllers and are currently in the process of acquiring a Steam Controller in order to make sure that everything works smoothly on all controller types. You will still need a mouse and keyboard to launch the game and select quality and resolution settings and the controller support hasn't been fully implemented with the multiplayer menus. However controllers will work on all the main single player menus and the main game experience. 

[h1]Control Scheme Change Defaults[/h1]
E on keyboard is 'A' on Xbox 360
TAB on keyboard is 'RB' on Xbox 360
ESC on keyboard is 'B' on Xbox 360
SPACE on keyboard is 'LEFT TRIGGER' on Xbox 360
MOUSE-CLICK on mouse is 'RIGHT TRIGGER' on Xbox 360
RB and LB on Xbox 360 are also used to toggle blessings options at an Altar.

[b]Justifying Jump on Left Trigger[/b]
The reason the jump button has been default mapped to left trigger instead of the standard 'A' button was so that players can have both thumbs on the analog sticks while also being able to jump so that they can smoothly adjust the game camera and their own guns aim while also being able to dodge and shoot unhindered.


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the Yellow Submarine Torpedos would collide with the Yellow Submarine itself. 
[*]Fixed a bug where multiple Brans would appear in Level 1 and Level 2.
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing "Esc" button in Blessing menu would take you straight to the Pause menu.
[*]Fixed a Multiplayer bug where players would spawn in and not be able to move.
[*]Fixed a Multiplayer bug where the player's health bar was not displaying correctly.[/list]

[b]Balance Updates[/b]
[list][*]Increased base bullet speed from 55 to 75 to improve game feel.[/list]

[b]Added Content[/b]
[list][*]There are now 4 random colour pallets per level. These colour pallets are linked to the seeding system so a certain seed will always have a specific colour pallet for each level. 
[*]Partial controller support for Xbox 360 controllers (and all similar models). 
[*]Two new NPCs have been added; DrDando and Tau.
[*]Brontes has been given a new look.[/list]

notes.title: Invincibility Frames! + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, thanks so much for the amazing feedback and community response it's really been amazing!

I wanted to do a quick patch addressing the most prominent things people addressed before I do a much larger update at the end of the week which will include some more content.

The most prominent change everyone asked for was the addition of invincibility frames, I can completely see why this change would suit Polygod and have implemented it.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Invincibility frames have been added to combat. Specifically 3 frames of invincibility after you have been hit.
[*] The GUI for the cross-hair has been updated to be significantly more accurate, it has also been adjusted to 100% accurate with Laser Shots at longer distances.
[*] Laser shots has had a bug fixed where if you missed an object the laser beam would not spawn. The beams always spawn regardless of whether you hit or not.
[*] It was discovered that you could exit the level and go back to the most recent room of rest, this was not intended, exiting the level (or boss fight) is considered a forfeit and you must restart the game (this is a rogue-like). This was due to a save load error, the error has been addressed and the system will work as follows. In the room of rest you can at any time exit the game and continue your current play-through from that room of rest at a later stage, however if you are in the game level or a boss fight and choose to quit to title this will be considered a forfeit and you will be sent back to the beginning of the game. The GUI in the pause menu will reflect this change with different text namely it will say "SAVE AND QUIT TO TITLE" when in a room of rest and "QUIT TO TITLE" in any other location.
[/list]

Please keep the feedback coming it is hugely helpful! I have added all other received feedback to a long list I'm working through for the next big update.
